annotations.title: SEC EDGAR full-text search of company filings

description: Full-text search of SEC EDGAR filings since 2001 (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy, S-1, exhibits and more): keywords, "exact phrase", OR, NOT, NEAR and trailing * wildcard, filtered by form type, ticker or CIK and filing date range. Returns total hits, hits by form, top filers and matching documents with company, CIK, ticker, form, filing date, period, accession number, 8-K items and sec.gov document URL. Insider Forms 3, 4, 5 and 144 excluded. Source: SEC EDGAR Full-Text Search. Price: $0.005 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

cik.description: Only documents filed by or about this SEC Central Index Key, 1 to 10 digits; individual (natural-person) filers are not served. Mutually exclusive with ticker.

end_date.description: Latest filing date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

forms.description: Comma-separated EDGAR form types, e.g. 10-K,10-Q,8-K,DEF 14A,S-1. A form also matches its /A amendments; list only /A forms to match amendments alone. Default: all forms except 3, 4, 5, 144 and MA-I (never searched).

q.description: Keywords or "exact phrase", 2 to 200 characters. All terms are required; OR between terms, NOT or a leading - to exclude, word NEAR(n) word for proximity (default 10 words) and a trailing * wildcard on a 3+ character stem (not inside a phrase, excluded, or next to OR).

sort.description: Result order: relevance (default), newest or oldest filing date.

start_date.description: Earliest filing date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: no lower bound (coverage starts 2001).

ticker.description: Only documents filed by or about this company, by stock ticker (e.g. AAPL). Mutually exclusive with cik.
